text:
Jules: Starting a small canary for mariner-7b-v2 in us-east-1 at 11:30 ET. Plan: ladder 2% -> 8% -> 15% over 40m. Gate rules: p99 latency < 900ms, 10m error rate < 0.3%, hallucination regression < 1.5% vs v1. If any gate trips, rollback and pin to mariner-7b-v1.
Priya: Adding preflight checks now. I'll wire the canary-smoke-2026 suite and add the perf dashboards.
Leo: Noted. Watch memory on 48G fleet for long-context loads; earlier run showed ~2.5GB extra with sparse attention. If OOM risk, switch to quant-fp16 variant.
Nina: Who owns the customer-facing blurb? We should warn about minor style and prompt behaviour changes.
Jules: I'll write a short blurb. Draft: "mariner-7b-v2: improved instruction following and throughput optimizations. To opt out, pin to mariner-7b-v1." Will push to release-notes if canary passes.
deploybot: deploybot: canary schedule set for 2026-03-22T15:30:00Z. Command: /deploy start --catalog mariner-7b-v2 --region us-east-1 --ladder 2,8,15 --checks telemetry,quality
Priya: Added fallback order to catalog: [mariner-7b-v2, mariner-7b-v1, ember-lite]. Confirmed tokenizer compat.
Leo: Recommend enabling prefix cache for api-v1 and assistant-proxy routes; should lower compute and p99.
Jules: Done. Config pushed to staging.
sre-bot: alert rule created: catalog.canary.p99.us-east-1 > 900ms for 5m -> severity: high -> channel: #incidents
deploybot: Stage 1 complete: 2% traffic -> OK. telemetry: p99=740ms, errors=0.08%, mem-avg=29.3GB
Jules: Move to 8%.
deploybot: Stage 2 complete: 8% traffic -> warning on quality. telemetry: p99=880ms, errors=0.22%, hallucination_delta=1.8%
Priya: hallucination delta slightly over 1.5% threshold. Do we stop?
Nina: Can we inspect failed prompts quickly? If failures concentrated on a small prompt family we might continue with a note and flag for research.
Leo: I'm pulling the sample logs now. Looks like a cluster of long-context summarization prompts are responsible. Memory also had small spikes but not OOM.
deploybot: Stage 3 hold until review.
Jules: Hold and investigate. Priya, capture the sample set and save to s3://canary-artifacts/mariner7b-v2/1750009999/
Priya: Saved samples + telemetry + flamegraphs. Link: s3://canary-artifacts/mariner7b-v2/1750009999/
Leo: Quick idea: try a smaller final step to 12% instead of 15% and enable the fp16-quant variant for the last stage. That might reduce hallucination delta.
Nina: Research says fp16 variant reduces hallucination on few-shot summarization sometimes. Worth trying.
Jules: Everyone OK with trying fp16 variant at final stage? If it still breaches, we rollback.
All: :+1:
deploybot: executing modified stage 3 -> 12% traffic on mariner-7b-v2.fp16
deploybot: Stage 3 complete: 12% traffic -> gate breach. telemetry: p99=940ms, errors=0.29%, hallucination_delta=2.2%
Jules: We're breaching p99 and hallucination gates. Initiate rollback to mariner-7b-v1 and pin. Deploybot, execute.
deploybot: rollback initiated -> routing back to mariner-7b-v1; applying pin: catalog.pin=mariner-7b-v1
deploybot: rollback complete. Post-rollback telemetry: p99=760ms, errors=0.09%, mem-avg=28.7GB, hallucination_delta=0.0%
Priya: Marking canary as failed in the rollout doc and filing artifacts. Saved artifacts at s3://canary-artifacts/mariner7b-v2/1750009999/
Leo: Uploading heap profiles and tracer logs from the 12% stage. Noticed a pattern with long multi-turn summarizes.
Nina: I'll open a cross-team follow-up: tagging research, infra, and product for a triage tomorrow 9:30 ET. Action items: longer hallucination evals (10k prompts), quant profile tuning, and smaller ladders for next attempt.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0429 - mariner-7b-v2 canary breaches. Assigned: Jules, Priya, Leo. Severity: medium.
Jules: Adding temporary routing rule to prefer ember-lite for assistant-proxy until we're green. Also drafting the rollback note for release-notes: "mariner-7b-v2 postponed; telemetry and quality gates triggered during canary."
Priya: Thanks. I'll notify support and escalate if customers ask.
Jules: Closing this thread. Follow-up invite sent.
